destroyed_h0_control.interpretation: achievable linear recoverability, not a proof of information-theoretic sufficiency/loss

h0_only_probes.interpretation: achievable linear recoverability, not a proof of information-theoretic sufficiency/loss

probe.decision: decoder_only only if every validation probe gate passes
probe.inputs: h0 and fixed carrier/slot identity only

protocol.selection: first scheduled validation checkpoint passing all gates; test once

rationale: decoder-only permitted only by all held-out byte/signature/extent probe gates; otherwise joint training is conservative, not proof of irrecoverable encoder loss
